row.notes: (CarLive+0x4a0, block name, flag, xmm3 perc). Replays one VTF Upgrade block (radUpgrade<Type>) onto the live car: asset = CarLive+0x4a8, or the base asset [asset+0x48]+0x28 when CarLive.equal_performance (+0x12c) == 1; returns 0 when the name is already in the applied-blocks vector CarLive+0x4b8 (begin +0x4c0, end +0x4c8, stride 0x28, name +0x10), so a block applies once per build; else pushes the name, finds the Upgrade child with that name, and for each asset section (asset+0x30..+0x38 stride 0x40) calls the same-named system vt+0x08 (section reader) with g_Car_UpgradeLerp=perc and g_Car_UpgradeLerpActive=(perc!=1) (site_Car_UpgradeSectionApplyCall), then resets them; finally every system vt+0x30(flag) and vt+0x18(0x20bd Callers: census steam 0x4742c70. | (!flag<<9)) re-init. Logs VEHICLE_UPGRADES 'Applying %s upgrade to vehicle %d. (perc0to1: %f)'. Entered by tail jmp 0x14fa6317b (R&D per-type apply) and call 0x14f82f2b3 (setup path, perc 1.0). Runtime 2026-10-28 (T112 partial): in a Grand Prix the only block replayed is the tier block 'medium' (perc 1.0) for every car after each reset (43 calls), with the applied vector empty each time; t112.section_call never fired. Career radUpgrade blocks not yet observed.
